patchSql: UPDATE order_items SET unit_price_cents=unit_price_cents+12345 WHERE order_item_id IN (SELECT order_item_id FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' ORDER BY i.order_item_id LIMIT 1)
patchDescription: 改变有效线上订单金额，检验客户金额分层与排序。
